Support

Email us at support@croppr.com.au. We usually reply within one business day.

In the app

  • Report a person, job or review: use the flag button. Reports go to the Croppr team, not the other person.
  • A farm marked you as a no-show by mistake: open Matches and tap “Not right? Dispute it”.
  • Not getting notifications: check Profile → Notifications in Croppr, and that notifications are allowed for Croppr in your phone’s settings.

If you’re in danger

Call 000. For workplace rights and pay, contact the Fair Work Ombudsman on 13 13 94.

Delete your account

In the app: Profile → Delete my account. This permanently deletes your profile, visa details, photos, payslips, resume and messages.

Can’t open the app? Email support@croppr.com.au from the address you sign in with and ask us to delete your account. We’ll do it within 30 days and let you know.

Privacy

Read our privacy policy. For privacy questions or to see the information we hold about you, email support@croppr.com.au.
